title: A matrix opened from a bookmark shows the Matrices breadcrumb
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Have matrix A's page opened from tier A's page and its address bookmarked.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps: 1. Open the bookmark in a new browser tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's page opens.
  • The breadcrumb reads Pricing › Matrices › matrix A's name, not the tier path.
